items.text: Subscribe for Bryan

The fact that Brian stayed all night means, you may have saved that birds life. If he had the energy to fly from you he would have.
Glad we stayed above water (no submarines pls) 😂

Hi Jimmy! Here’s a challenge you haven’t done yet: 100 Days Living on a Boat.
Start with a basic boat and earn upgrades, food and supplies by completing challenges at sea. Every failure makes the boat smaller or removes an essential item. Last person remaining wins the boat plus $1,000,000.
